anime4k09-kernel-reference.npz contains a deterministic 16x12 BGR input and
32x24 expected output. Input: numpy.default_rng(543).integers(0,256,(12,16,3),
dtype=uint8), then first column=0, last column=255.

The expected edge-pass output was generated independently by compiling the
original getGradient and pushGradient OpenCL kernel functions from Anime4KCPP
v2.5.0, commit f2ad479327fea35e29fef29b66c43ce3faaa1cd4, as scalar C++ with
Clang extended vector types. Image-read/write wrappers emulate clamp-to-edge
sampling and UNORM8 buffers. Initial 2x float bilinear resize and luminance
packing used OpenCV. Three passes used gradient strength 0.5. The result was
not generated by our NumPy implementation.

The kernel wrappers and generated C++ are retained locally in the gitignored
build/anime4k09-reference directory. One uint8 level of tolerance covers float
operation ordering. This verifies the port's rules, not a phone GPU execution.
